notes: Cool grays and brushed-metal neutrals dominate. Small utilitarian accents (caution orange #E25822, indicator yellow #F5C518, technical blue #3A7BD5) used sparingly. Atmospheric grays for skies. Agricultural greens for aerial fields. The Recast Systems logomark uses its own four-color palette — burnt orange #DA5E15, marigold #FBBF27, cobalt blue #2F5EDC, sky cyan #6BD0ED — and these only appear together when the logomark itself is on the page. No saturated primaries flooding the frame.
